# Icon

Owned Aleem icon set: 24px grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps, 20% currentColor duotone tint.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Icon` · Icons

## Use

```jsx
<AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Icon name={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.Icon" name="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

Aleem icon: owned duotone set on a 24px grid, currentColor, RTL-aware for directional glyphs.

## Props (IconProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` * | `IconName \| string` | Icon name from the Aleem set. Common Lucide names (x, refresh-cw, messages-square, alert-triangle...) resolve via aliases. |
| `size` | `number` | Pixel size (square). 16 inline with text, 20 in controls, 24 in feature tiles, 32 in hero tiles. @default 20 |
| `duotone` | `boolean` | Draw the 20% currentColor tint under the stroke. Turn off at 16px or on busy backgrounds. @default true |
| `strokeWidth` | `number` | Stroke width in grid units. 1.75 at 20 to 24px; 2 at 16px. @default 1.75 |
| `label` | `string` | Accessible name when the icon stands alone (no visible label). Omit when a label sits next to it. |

_Also accepts: Omit<React.SVGAttributes<SVGSVGElement>, 'name'>._
